GPU_policy: one H3b exclusive GPU lock shared across every H3b arm; per-arm training7200s; real-worker PID handshake before torch/GPU. Prior H3 processes must already be ended.

g1_provenance.adaptation: Official G1 architecture and graph adapter parameters retained. Classification head/NLL/class balance become regression head/TRAIN-only standardized MSE; validation BA becomes template-weighted MAE. Template weights replace G1 association-group weights.

g1_parameters.early_stopping: maximum inner-validation original-group-weighted BA; first epoch wins ties
g1_parameters.refit: fresh initialization on all outer TRAIN for selected inner epoch count

group_policy: synthetic template/real reduced composition; only TRAIN groups choose inner validation

parameters.censoring: If at least one full-TRAIN refit epoch checkpoint exists, evaluate latest completed refit epoch once as time_censored; otherwise censored_inner_only/missing and no TEST prediction. No inner-only substitution.
parameters.loss: TRAIN-only standardized-target MSE with inverse-current-training-group-size weights normalized to mean1
parameters.refit: fresh seed+100 initialization on all corresponding TRAIN rows for selected inner epoch count
parameters.selection: minimum inverse-validation-group-size MAE; first qualifying epoch wins ties
parameters.test_policy: TEST/HOLDOUT structures only; no evaluation targets read for normalization, checkpoint selection or scoring; final TRAIN predictions are private diagnostics

prediction_policy: TEST/HOLDOUT structures only; no evaluation targets read for normalization, checkpoint selection or scoring; final TRAIN predictions are private diagnostics
